name: Sheng Yu Steel Co., Ltd.
summary: Sheng Yu Steel Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise primarily engaged in the production, processing, and distribution of a diverse range of steel sheets. Their extensive product portfolio includes various galvanized steel options, such as Al-Zn alloy-coated and standard galvanized steel coils, along with their pre-painted versions. The company also specializes in cold rolled steel sheets and coils. They offer a wide array of specialized coated steel sheets, including chrome-free anti-fingerprint zinc and Al-Zn alloy-coated types, pre-painted and printed color sheets, single-side pre-painted anti-fingerprint galvanized sheets, and specific anti-static, antiseptic, and low-gloss pre-painted coated steel sheets. Furthermore, their offerings extend to unique pre-painted steel coils like two-tone, pearl, baroque embossed, and anti-dirt varieties, in addition to whiteboards and blackboards. Complementing its manufacturing operations, Sheng Yu Steel is also active in steel trading and operates its own testing laboratory. Established in 1973, the company's headquarters are located in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, and it functions as a subsidiary of Yodogawa Steel Works, Ltd.
